Common Quantitative Trial Decision Rule

Source: R/class_design_quantitative.R
TrialDesignPlanQuantitativeBase.Rd

Internal ParameterSet base for frequentist and Bayesian quantitative decision rules. Obtain instances of its concrete subclasses with getDesignQuantitative().

Initializes shared reference parameters.

Prints the quantitative rule.

Renders the quantitative rule.

Returns the object description.

Arguments

...

Reserved for ParameterSet compatibility.

targetValue, lowerReferenceValue

Reference effects or NA.

upperPercentile, lowerPercentile

Reference percentiles or NA.

showType

Output mode.

digits

Display precision.

consoleOutputEnabled

Print or collect output.

startWithUpperCase

Capitalize the description.

Details

The reference values and percentiles are optional for explicit Bayesian rules. The concrete subclasses are TrialDesignPlanQuantitative and TrialDesignPlanQuantitativeBayes. ParameterSet supplies shared parameter and output management; internal dot-prefixed fields are implementation details.

Fields

targetValue

Optional target effect on the beneficial-effect scale. A supplied finite scalar for reference-value rules; NA for explicit Bayesian criteria.

lowerReferenceValue

Optional lower reference effect on the beneficial-effect scale. A supplied finite scalar for reference-value rules; NA for explicit Bayesian criteria.

upperPercentile

Upper percentile supplied for a reference-value rule, strictly between lowerPercentile and 1. NA for explicit Bayesian criteria. For Bayesian rules its interpretation is controlled by percentileMapping.

lowerPercentile

Lower percentile supplied for a reference-value rule, strictly between 0 and upperPercentile. NA for explicit Bayesian criteria. For Bayesian rules its interpretation is controlled by percentileMapping.
